items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-23
items.q: I worked in that place two years, man. Me and Lee and Son Andy, Roy Evans, Joe Robeshow, and Plekton, Rennie Hall.

ctx.x: Why, that's it. Yeah, I did see one one time. I was looking for Rene, and I went to this Cadillac Club down on St. Claude, and they had one there, you know. But I never paid attention to it, you know. I'd rather listen to the music and find the girls later.

Man, them cats are taking, you buy a dollar worth of tickets over there, that day when you come in. The girls sitting all up there, now. With a dollar worth of it. Ten cents a dance. But the girls got a string of tickets about that long. You know. Mm-hmm. You start at the bottom, see. Boy, now they got a guy walk around. Mm-hmm. Take them tickets from you, you know. Mm-hmm. Girl got the tickets. She done snapped it off. Mm-hmm. Well, you get it this end. Band of the top, you know. Time for another snap-off…
